### Note for Authors - Please Review 

<details>

EIP Editors are here to support authors, answer questions, and help resolve specific issues or blockers.

* Have a PR you’d like to discuss? Please add the PR number/link and your specific question or blocker in the comments. We’ll add it to the agenda for discussion.
* New EIP reviews follow the review queue and may be completed asynchronously. You do not need to attend Office Hours just to request a review.
* Have another EIP process question or topic you’d like to discuss? Please add it to the comments as well.

Authors are always welcome to join, ask questions, and participate in the discussion.

</details>

Thanks for carrying #1879, #2005 and #2012 into the New Proposals queue. A short status on each, since nothing has moved since the last session:

#1879 ERC-8338 Token-Bound Executable Skills — @jochem-brouwer’s 11-03 review left two required items (RFC 8949 link, abbreviation expansions) and noted the PR could be merged as Draft once those were done. Both were addressed on 11-05 and review was re-requested on 11-06; CI green. If an editor can confirm the two items, this one should be ready to merge.
#2005 ERC-8414 Token-Bound Task Tenders — all six blocking items from the 11-03 review addressed; re-requested 11-06; CI green.
#2012 ERC-8419 Know-Your-Agent (KYA) Framework — all five blocking items from the 11-03 review addressed; re-requested 11-06; CI green.

Two older PRs that have not had a first editor review yet, if there is room:

#2044 ERC-8434 Agent Identity (AID) — open since 09-30; the title was auto-set by the bot and has been corrected to “Add ERC: …”; diff is ERCS/erc-8434.md plus assets/erc-8434/ only; CI green; Magicians discussion (35 posts) settled.
#2081 ERC-8447 Swarm AI Framework — open since 10-18; no reviewer is currently requested on it (the bot’s auto-approval was dismissed when the ERC file was re-added); CI green; Magicians thread settled at rev 2.2.

Hi editors, thank you for running these sessions.
Requesting a slot for ERC-8423 (https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2032), new ERC (Draft).
Number assigned on 24/09/2026, file renamed to `ERCS/erc-8423.md`, CI green since then; editor review requested on 23/09/2026.
Question for editors: is there anything missing on my side before it can be merged as Draft?
I can't join live; happy to follow up on any feedback in the PR. Thanks!
Gm! I request a slot for a re-review of https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1962. All comments were addressed and ERC should be good enough to be merged as Draft

PR for review: ethereum/ERCs#1984 — ERC-8406 (Fungible Agent Tokens), a new ERC draft.

Open since Sep 1; renumbered per the associate's assignment, all feedback addressed, 0 unresolved conversations, CI green. It has been awaiting its first editor review for over two months. Async handling is perfectly fine if that is easier — just hoping to get it into the queue. Thank you!

Update on ERC-8448 (ethereum/ERCs#2082), already in the queue: both editorial fixes are in `9217699`, and CI is green. The [implementation tests](https://github.com/haot3x/agent-order-amendments/pull/7) are now merged, with 95 passing cases. Could an editor re-review the fixes for Draft inclusion? Async review works for me.

Hi, @poojaranjan 
Please add https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1688, https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1955 and https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1549. They are ready to move to Draft.
Thanks!
